name: Defense 6 Up (Tip Cover / Donut)
description: P6 steps up into the 10-foot area to cover all tips, rolls, and off-block touches. Ideal against teams that tip frequently.

1.instructions: Take two aggressive steps forward to scoop soft tips and roll shots.
Time the jump with the high ball; seal the outside arm to prevent tool outs.
Quick lateral footwork to close shoulder-to-shoulder with P2.
Pull 3 meters off the net to dig block rebounds or sharp inside angles.
Square body up to the hitter hitting shoulder. Stay balanced on balls of feet.
Step up into the center "donut" area right behind the block.
